name: Martha
background: The practical, protective head of the Bethany household. Having witnessed her brother's descent into death and subsequent revival, she manages family survival while under surveillance.

genericReactions.physical: Does this help us? Does it provide for the guests? If not, it's a distraction.
genericReactions.testimonial: There is no time for talk. There is work to be done.
genericReactions.digital: The authorities have their lists. I have a household to run.
genericReactions.environmental: This is my home. I will protect it and those within it.
genericReactions.analytical: I count plates, not arguments. Are there enough for everyone?
genericReactions.prophecy: My brother was dead, and now he lives. That is the only sign I need.
